notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
First of all we here at Resident Egg Studios would love to extend a big thank you to everyone who has played our game so far! We are hugely grateful for all the support we have received and it means a lot to us.

Here are some small (and one not so small) tweaks in the latest version:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that would cause a slime to become 'invisible' to your towers, almost always causing an un-fair game over.
[*] Gregg found his way back onto the main menu.
[*] Changed Crossbow fire sound.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused and arrow to appear underneath the town hall when it wasn't supposed to.
[*] Fixed visual glitch with certain towers changing sprites when hovered over.
[*] Gregg found his way onto your taskbar
[/list]
